I will keep my land in the usual, steady pattern for Quzhou County: winter wheat followed by summer maize on the same fields. I am 60, so I will choose a system I know well, can manage with machinery, and can count on for grain and cash flow. I do not want to spread myself across too many crops that need more hand labor or more market risk. Wheat and maize fit my local water, soil, and weather conditions, and I understand their field timing, fertilizer use, irrigation, and pest control. I will use improved seed, put most of the fertilizer into a balanced base application and then topdress nitrogen when the crop needs it, irrigate only at the key stages, and keep pesticide use limited to the times when pressure is likely to matter. I will use rotary tillage because it is practical for me and matches the way I would prepare land between crops.
